# International Studies in Philosophy

> [!CAUTION]
> **Publication status:** Appears to have ceased publication — OpenAlex records **no publications since 2008** (checked 2026-07-30, ISSN 0270-5664). This entry is retained for historical reference and for rejection-fallback context, but **should not be recommended as a live submission target**. Suspended by its editor in 2008 at volume 40(2). Acquired by the Philosophy Documentation Center in 2011 for reorganization; no issues have appeared since. If this is an OpenAlex indexing gap rather than a real closure, please open an issue (see [docs/GOVERNANCE.md](../../../../../docs/GOVERNANCE.md)).
